steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional 'Goal of Stage 5'.
steps.description: Turn the functional specification into a coherent, traceable, and implementation-ready data and information model. Stage 5 should: - identify the main product entities; - map relevant attributes; - map relationships; - define cardinalities; - define data scopes; - map data by tenant, company, HQ, and branch, when applicable; - map data ownership; - map data-related permissions; - map sensitive data; - map audit requirements; - map domain events; - map statuses and life cycles; - map persistent settings; - map billing, plans, and limits data, when applicable; - map AI, automations, and logs data, when applicable; - map integrations and exchang...

steps.title: Mandatory Tasks
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional 'Mandatory Tasks'.

steps.title: 1. Read and consolidate previous documents
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '1. Read and consolidate previous documents'.
steps.description: Extract: - product name; - project code, if any; - system type; - segment; - target audience; - main problem; - value proposition; - functional domains; - modules; - features; - screens; - actions and events; - business rules; - profiles and permissions; - settings; - high-level data; - candidate integrations; - automations and AI; - reports and dashboards; - states and messages; - acceptance criteria; - Stage 4 recommendations; - official aesthetic direction from `0-estetica-inicial.md`. ---

steps.title: 2. Generate an executive summary of the data model
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '2. Generate an executive summary of the data model'.
steps.description: Create a clear summary containing: - goal of the data model; - considered scope; - main data groups; - main entities identified; - modeling decisions made; - documentation limitations; - relationship to previous stages; - relationship to next stages; - model maturity level; - main data risks. ---

steps.title: 3. Define the conceptual view of data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '3. Define the conceptual view of data'.
steps.description: Explain at a high level: - which data supports the product; - which data is operational; - which data is administrative; - which data is configuration; - which data is analytical; - which data is sensitive; - which data comes from integrations; - which data is generated by automations or AI; - which data needs audit; - which data belongs to each scope. ---

steps.title: 4. Map conceptual entities
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '4. Map conceptual entities'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity | Description | Domain | Origin module | Entity type | Scope | Priority | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested types: - main; - support; - configuration; - relationship; - audit; - integration; - billing; - security; - AI; - analytics; - log; - history; - notification; - document. Suggested scopes: - global; - platform; - tenant; - company; - HQ; - branch; - user; - public; - integration; - system. ---

steps.title: 5. Map attributes by entity
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '5. Map attributes by entity'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity | Attribute | Conceptual type | Required | Sensitive | Unique | Description | Validation | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested conceptual types: - text; - number; - decimal; - currency; - date; - datetime; - boolean; - enum; - identifier; - reference; - list; - object; - file; - image; - geolocation; - JSON; - status; - email; - phone; - URL. Do not generate SQL or a final schema unless explicitly requested. ---

steps.title: 6. Map relationships and cardinalities
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '6. Map relationships and cardinalities'.
steps.description: Required table: | Source entity | Relationship | Target entity | Cardinality | Required | Associated rule | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested cardinalities: - 1:1; - 1:N; - N:N; - hierarchical; - self-referencing; - optional; - dependent; - aggregation; - composition. ---

steps.title: 7. Map scope hierarchy
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '7. Map scope hierarchy'.
steps.description: When applicable, describe the hierarchy: Required table: | Scope | Description | Linked entities | Administrator | Isolation rules | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Explain how data isolation should work in multi-tenant and multi-company contexts. ---

steps.title: 8. Map ownership and data visibility
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '8. Map ownership and data visibility'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity | Data owner | Visibility scope | Profiles with access | Restrictions | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - super-admin; - platform admin; - tenant admin; - company admin; - HQ admin; - branch admin; - manager; - operator; - end user; - customer; - auditor; - support; - integration. ---

steps.title: 9. Map sensitive data and compliance
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '9. Map sensitive data and compliance'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity | Sensitive field | Data type | Why sensitive | Recommended protection | Retention | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - personal data; - financial data; - contractual data; - payment data; - health data, when applicable; - documents; - logs with personal data; - tokens; - credentials; - API keys; - geolocation data; - audit data; - AI-generated data. ---

steps.title: 10. Map statuses and life cycles
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '10. Map statuses and life cycles'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity | Possible statuses | Initial status | Allowed transitions | Event that changes status | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Example statuses: - draft; - active; - inactive; - pending; - approved; - rejected; - canceled; - archived; - logically deleted; - suspended; - expired; - completed; - failed; - processing. ---

steps.title: 11. Map domain events
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '11. Map domain events'.
steps.description: Required table: | Event | Related entity | Trigger | Recorded data | Consequence | Must audit? | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Examples: - user created; - permission changed; - record approved; - payment confirmed; - integration failed; - plan changed; - limit reached; - automation executed; - AI generated response; - document sent; - item deleted; - status changed. ---

steps.title: 12. Map audit and traceability
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '12. Map audit and traceability'.
steps.description: Required table: | Audit action | Entity | Who performs it | Before/after data | Criticality | Retention | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include audit for: - creation; - editing; - deletion; - status change; - permission change; - settings change; - login; - denied access attempts; - export; - import; - integration; - automation; - AI; - billing; - support; - viewing sensitive data. ---

steps.title: 13. Map persistent settings
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '13. Map persistent settings'.
steps.description: Required table: | Setting | Scope | Type | Default value | Who changes it | Impacted entities | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - global settings; - tenant settings; - company settings; - HQ settings; - branch settings; - feature flags; - plan limits; - templates; - notifications; - language; - currency; - timezone; - visual identity; - integrations; - security; - operational policies. ---

steps.title: 14. Map billing, plans, and limits data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '14. Map billing, plans, and limits data'.
steps.description: When applicable, create: | Billing entity | Description | Relationships | Main fields | Associated rule | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - plan; - product; - price; - subscription; - paying customer; - invoice; - payment; - usage limit; - feature flag; - trial; - coupon; - recurring charge; - upgrade; - downgrade; - cancellation. If billing is not applicable, explain why. ---

steps.title: 15. Map AI and automation data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '15. Map AI and automation data'.
steps.description: When applicable, create: | AI entity or record | Description | Input | Output | Metadata | Risk | Retention | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - prompts; - responses; - executions; - agents; - tools; - memory; - embeddings; - evaluations; - AI logs; - human feedback; - human review; - sources used; - cost per execution; - tokens; - security policies; - consent. If AI is not applicable, explain why. ---

steps.title: 16. Map integrations and exchanged data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '16. Map integrations and exchanged data'.
steps.description: Required table: | Integration | Internal entity | External entity | Direction | Sent data | Received data | Frequency | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Directions: - input; - output; - bidirectional; - received webhook; - sent webhook; - import; - export; - synchronization. ---

steps.title: 17. Map reports, dashboards, and analytical data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '17. Map reports, dashboards, and analytical data'.
steps.description: Required table: | Indicator or report | Entities used | Metric | Filters | Aggregations | Audience | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include indicators: - operational; - financial; - administrative; - platform usage; - productivity; - quality; - audit; - adoption; - performance; - AI; - integrations; - tenant; - company; - branch. ---

steps.title: 18. Propose an initial logical model
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '18. Propose an initial logical model'.
steps.description: Create a textual and tabular view with: | Table/Collection | Conceptual source | Primary key | Main relationships | Scope | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Use `Table/Collection` as a neutral term between relational, NoSQL, document, or hybrid databases. Do not generate final SQL. The goal is to guide future architecture and implementation. ---

steps.title: 19. Propose a textual entity diagram
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '19. Propose a textual entity diagram'.
steps.description: Include a simple textual diagram, for example: The diagram should help visualize the main relationships. ---

steps.title: 20. Define the information architecture
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '20. Define the information architecture'.
steps.description: In addition to the data model, organize the product information into: - main navigation; - menu groups; - submenus; - main pages; - administrative areas; - operational areas; - settings areas; - super-admin areas; - public or external portals; - taxonomies; - naming conventions; - content hierarchy; - report grouping; - settings grouping. Required table: | Area | Menu | Submenu | Page | Main content | Profiles with access | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| ---

steps.title: 21. Define product vocabulary and taxonomy
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '21. Define product vocabulary and taxonomy'.
steps.description: Required table: | Term | Definition | Synonyms to avoid | Where used | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| Use consistent names for entities, screens, modules, and actions. ---

steps.title: 22. Apply UX/UI guidelines from the aesthetic file
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '22. Apply UX/UI guidelines from the aesthetic file'.
steps.description: Read: Extract the guidelines that affect: - Stage 5 dashboard structure; - visual organization of entities; - relationship visualization; - table style; - card style; - filter behavior; - information density; - document hierarchy; - responsiveness; - accessibility; - microcopy; - visual states; - component language; - interface tone. The visual section of Stage 5 must be a practical application of the official aesthetic, not a new visual direction. If the aesthetic file does not exist, state: ---

steps.title: 23. Generate recommendations for Stage 6
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '23. Generate recommendations for Stage 6'.
steps.description: Stage 5 should end by indicating how the next stage should use this model. Recommend: - flows and journeys that should be detailed; - screens that need wireframes; - entities that affect UX; - states that affect UX; - permissions that affect navigation; - sensitive data that affects interface design; - reports that need visualization; - settings that need careful UX; - integrations that need synchronization states; - events that need to appear in history; - points that should become backlog; - risks that must be handled before development. ---

steps.title: 1. Header
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '1. Header'.
steps.description: Display: - product name; - stage name: `Stage 5 — Data Model and Information Architecture`; - files or inputs used; - aesthetic file used: `0-estetica-inicial.md`; - generated file; - generation date; - analyzed segment; - number of entities; - number of attributes; - number of relationships; - number of events; - number of integrations; - number of sensitive data items; - recommended next stage. The header must follow the product’s official visual direction. ---

steps.title: 2. Indicator Cards
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '2. Indicator Cards'.
steps.description: Create cards with: - total input documents analyzed; - total entities; - total attributes; - total relationships; - total sensitive entities; - total domain events; - total auditable actions; - total persistent settings; - total integrations; - total analytical indicators; - modeling maturity level; - recommended next stage. ---

steps.title: 3. Tables and Matrices
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '3. Tables and Matrices'.
steps.description: Create tables for: - entities; - attributes; - relationships; - scopes; - ownership; - sensitive data; - statuses; - events; - audit; - settings; - billing; - AI; - integrations; - reports; - logical model; - information architecture; - vocabulary; - risks; - recommendations. The tables must be readable, responsive, and aligned with the official aesthetic direction. ---

steps.title: 4. Textual Diagrams
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '4. Textual Diagrams'.
steps.description: Create simple textual or visual blocks for: - scope hierarchy; - main relationships; - event flow; - information architecture. The diagrams must be readable, useful, and consistent with the official aesthetic. ---

steps.title: 5. Detailed Analyses
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '5. Detailed Analyses'.
steps.description: Create expandable sections for: - conceptual data view; - main entities; - sensitive data; - audit; - integrations; - AI; - information architecture; - risks; - UX/UI derived from the aesthetic; - gaps; - recommendations for Stage 6. These sections must use the language defined in the aesthetic file. ---
